outcome.Summary: Ported reference/cron.py to Go package cron (cron/cron.go) with the exact required API: Schedule (unexported fields), Parse, Next, String. Behavior matches the reference including all CronError messages (verified via a mini Python-repr) and the Vixie day-matching/next-run semantics, including a fix for Go's value-receiver mutation gotcha on the field bitsets. Tests in cron/cron_test.go and cron/differential_test.go compare Go output against the Python reference on ~570 inputs (syntax, errors, next runs, describe, and 500 randomized differential cases with 2 seeds); `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0 and the workspace contains only the new cron/ directory.
